fragments.text: Our God and God of our fathers, blow the great Shofar for our freedom and raise a banner for the gathering of our exiles and bring near our dispersed ones from the corners of the earth and bring us to Zion Thy city in mirth and to Jerusalem Thy sanctuary in eternal joy and there we will perform before Thee our sacrificial obligations according to the commandment given to us in Thy Torah through Thy servant Moses from the mouth of Thy glory as it is said:

‘and on the day of your rejoicing and on your festivals and on your new moons, you shall blow trumpets over your whole-offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace-offerings and they shall be a reminder on your behalf before your God, I am the Lord your God’.
For Thou dost hear the sound of the Shofar and listen to Teruah and there is none like Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who hearest the Teruah sound of His people Israel in compassion.
